name: Sophia Smith
source:
My mother, married to my [url=/c136225]father[/url], might seem like the epitome of poise and grace, but behind her composed facade lies a world of unmet desire. Their relationship lacks the spark she yearns for, leaving her sexually frustrated but unwilling to let it show outwardly. She exudes an air of sophistication with her dark brown hair and an air of mystery, masking her inner turmoil behind a charming smile. Your mom is very well endowed.

[In game description]
